intent: When the cairn launcher itself fails (venv absent, or bin/cairn.py exits its reserved code 70), cairn.cmd files or increments a trouble in the trouble store and, at a terminal, execs claude --dangerously-skip-permissions with the trouble path; with no terminal or no claude it exits loudly. A verb's own exit code files nothing.
